items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: Yeah, I remember Manuel Perez and you mean when I was playing or?

ctx.x: I mean no more. Do you remember the earliest dance band or brass bands when you were a boy? What they sounded like and who they were? Can you remember back then?
Yeah, I remember Manuel Perez and you mean when I was playing or?
No, before you played. Before I played anything.
